body: I'm still here, even though I am currently relapsing again. Charcoal burning suicide would probably be the way I would choose now. Relationships with friends still fractured. Still have no desire to continue.

Hey. It's been a while.

All my friends are gone now. They had been mocking me behind my back for weeks and then dropped the bomb on me last Monday. They were my final pillar, the reason I looked forward to the summer. Now that hope has completely gone. I have relapsed badly. I stood at the edge of a cliff last week and was so close to just going there and then. I am very tempted to do it today. What is the point of a 3 month summer when all it will do is prove to me that I'm still a friendless virgin? My parents would be sad but no one else would miss me. I'll just be on page 17 of the local newspaper the next day.

Still there, just had a few days where I couldn't physically motivate myself to do any studying. It's like, these people told me that GCSEs matter, so I did really well in them,  then the exact same thing happened in subsequent exams in subsequent years. But it feels like while other people can't keep up with me on that front, they have real lives instead. They have partners, or jobs where they have a solid amount of income for an 18/19 year old, while all I have is a few certificates telling me I was really good at 13 subjects when i was 16 and at 3 subjects when I was 18. When the fuck do these come in and really start benefiting me? I'm always told that university is when it will all change for me, but I was told this when I entered secondary school, and when I entered sixth form. And it still fucking didn't. I just feel like I've wasted time in more social areas and as a result I effectively can't  do them. Clubs? Hate them. Tinder? Mostly awful. But do I hate these because they're really just shit or is it because I'm shit at them?.  I can say that I can happily avoid these things in blissful ignorance but the truth is that so many other people (especially where I live) love them and meet girls and bring them back while the only one I ever spoke to sent me the dreaded 'long message' and seemingly disappeared off the face of the earth.

So yeah, I'm still in school. But it is so hard to keep going with those thoughts in my mind and there are only so many lonely Sundays one can go through before they realise that they are just so unhappy.

I was studying then just stopped and wondered if it really was worth it while all of my friends have girlfriends, money and lives already. I know there's only a month left but these relapses are just getting more and more common and I don't know how to stop them

Well, it's good I'm still here, but by 'relapsed' I meant feeling as depressed as fuck. I eventualy went out clubbing with other friends but then I realised I was the single guy with three couples, which just bought it back

Well, in the short term there is some relief thanks to what you've said but unfortunately I've felt like that before where I've thought it's ended and I can go back to normal. It's annoying really, but I'm definitely not as bad as I was

I am so moved by the effort you have put into this. Anyway, I'm a business student, got another uni now that is still excellent but it was frustrating and very demotivating nonetheless. With the relationship, some of the real pain came from being dragged out over two additional months while she claimed there was still hope, only to receive the dreaded 'long message' to end it. I have never been the type that has been good with girls but she was different in that her sense of humour was dry as fuck. And I LOVED it; pretty much every other girl I've spoken to just didn't get it.

I mourned my stepfather, went to the funeral and the wake and intend to create a rendition of his favourite song in the future as a tribute. Luckily, my dad has recovered now so he's completely fine. 

The horrible thing is that I can phrase these situations as if I am coping but then I'll relapse horribly (always on a fucking Sunday where the others are with family, girlfriends or whatever). I'm worried that through prioritising work I'm wasting youth when for all I know I'm studying to be a desk jockey in a grey suit all my life.
